messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: PagerDuty incident triggered for service `inference-gateway-prod` (High) — incident #PD-98234. Symptoms: 5xx spike, increased tail latency, error rate > 5% for 3m. Link: https://pd.example/PD-98234

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: Incident PD-98234 — triggered by policy 'prod-critical'. Escalation: primary on-call alice.

alice: Ack'd. I'm looking. Seeing a rollout in kube infra-dashboard around the time of spike.

carla: @alice filed a canary earlier today? I pushed a small runtime change, but it passed smoke.

alice: Noted. Reproducing errors locally against current image shows KV cache key error: "kv_cache: invalid key length" in logs.

ben: Is this affecting all regions or just us-west1? New Relic shows errors mostly from us-west1 and eu-west.

alice: Mostly us-west1 but some eu-west traces too. Seems to correlate with requests routed to instance pool A (g4dn-... reserved).

incident-bot: PagerDuty: No ack by secondary (ben) within 2m — escalating to secondary/manager per policy.

ben: I'm on it, joining call. Can someone drop the failing service's pod logs?

carla: Dropping quick tail of logs from pod inference-gw-5cb9: ```
2026-06-10T15:02:11Z ERROR kv_cache: invalid key length: 0
2026-06-10T15:02:11Z WARN handler: request failed id=abc123 status=500
2026-06-10T15:02:12Z INFO routing: fallback to model-variant v1q
```

dmitri: Looks like a regression in the cache key computation after recent runtime change. I can try a hotfix.

alice: If we can revert the runtime shim on pool A that should stop new errors. How quick is a rollback?

carla: Rollback is fast. I can push a rollback to the canary image tag and it will roll to pool A in ~90s.

kate-manager: I'm getting escalated — pinging to coordinate customer comms. Any data on affected customers?

alice: Quick check: top 3 tenants by error rate — acme-inc (10% of requests failing), betaapp (8%), internal-monitoring (5%). Potential user-facing 503s.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Manager escalated to kate-manager (PD-98234) — acknowledged automatically on escalation.

kate-manager: Acknowledge. I'll prepare a short status to send to the on-call channel and customers if needed.

ben: Carla, please start rollback to canary image tag `inference-gw:2026-06-09-canary`. I'll watch metrics.

carla: rolling back now: ```bash
kubectl set image deploy/inference-gateway inference-gateway=inference-gw:2026-06-09-canary -n prod
```

incident-bot: Deploy bot: rollout started for deployment/inference-gateway (namespace prod).

alice: Watching CP. Metrics dashboard: errors dropping from 6.2% -> 2.1% within 60s of rollback start.

ben: Nice. Any sign of stateful corruption? We should ensure cache keys are invalid only for new requests.

dmitri: From logs, invalid key length seems generated at key-derive when optional header missing. I'll add guard and ship small patch to master after mitigation.

eva: I can coordinate a brief status update on statuspage: "Investigating: increased 5xx rates for inference-gateway; rollback initiated; mitigation in progress." Want me to post?

kate-manager: Yes, post that with note that we've initiated rollback and are monitoring. ETA for full recovery 5-10m.

eva: Posted to status (incident PD-98234).

incident-bot: PagerDuty: The incident has been acknowledged by alice, ben, and kate-manager.

carla: Rollout complete. All pods replaced in pool A.

alice: Errors down to 0.8% across cluster. Latency normalized. Marking as mitigated.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-98234 marked as "mitigated" by alice.

kate-manager: Good job team. I'll schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow to capture RCA and action items. Need follow-ups: (1) add guard in key derivation, (2) add canary-to-prod automated smoke test for kv cache, (3) tweak escalation timeout for mobile on-call.

ben: One quick note — pager duty didn't escalate ben fast enough (secondary timeout). We should verify PD policy settings; I didn't get mobile alert due to DND.

incident-bot: PD note: escalation was automatic after 2m no ack by primary. Secondary ack latency was 1m 50s (within window) but push didn't come through to ben's phone (DND). Policy triggers manager escalation at 4m.

carla: We'll add a post-incident ticket to update runbook with explicit rollback commands and add the small integration test.

dmitri: I'll open PR for fix and test, link to PD-98234.

alice: Closing thread for now. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

kate-manager: Thanks — please add incident timeline and owners to the postmortem doc.

eva: I'll create the postmortem doc and ping owners.

incident-bot: Reminder: incident PD-98234 — follow-up required: postmortem, owners assigned within 24h.

carla: noted.

alice: out.

ben: out.

-- end of thread --
